symmetry: D3 chiral dihedral (Schoenflies), order 6, generators rho:(w,z)->(e^{2 pi i/3} w, z) and kappa:(w,z)->(conj(w),-z) = (x,y,z)->(x,-y,-z), a half-turn about x
selection: nominee #8 of results/d3_candidates.json, accepted by the user with the relaxed basin gate 'every bounded orbit lands on the symmetric set' (results/d3_selection.json)

centroid_single_orbit.note: reported, not gated: 20-batch SE of one T = 16000 window; the 0.01 threshold sits only ~2 SE away on x, so a single-window pass or fail is weak evidence. The centring gate is B5c on the B9e ensemble.

symmetry_residuals.centering: origin (the only D3-fixed point); no re-centring

polyhedral_overgroups.description: every element outside D3 of the copies of O and I that contain this D3 (atlas.family_d.polyhedral_overgroups(3)); min residual per group copy

symmetry_residuals.rotation_scan_note: residual of rotations about z by 5..115 degrees. Points within a few degrees of 0 or 120 are close to a group element for any cloud and say nothing about symmetry; the gate uses the angles 120/k (k = 2..6) that a D_3k supergroup would add, plus the absence of any interior local minimum. Gate v1 used the scan minimum, which is the 5-degree point (2.9x) and failed for that reason; it is kept as pass_controls_3x_v1.

z_symmetry_single_orbit.omega_estimator: field-based (x ydot - y xdot)/(x^2+y^2), batch means (20 batches), [mean, se]
z_symmetry_single_orbit.note: single B5 orbit (T = 16000), reported, not gated. The orbit exchanges halves slowly (longest dwell below), so these averages converge slowly: the 0.01 P(z>0) threshold is ~1.4 batch SE and a T = 4000 window exceeds KS 0.02 about half the time. The gates are taken on the B9e ensemble.

ensemble.protocol: 64 ICs = random B5 orbit points + uniform(-0.1,0.1)^3 (rng seed 31); batched real-form RK4 at dt 0.004; T = 300 transient, T = 4000 window; time averages every 10 steps; z stored every 100 steps; mean +- standard error across orbits
ensemble.omega_estimator: field-based (x ydot - y xdot)/(x^2+y^2), averaged per orbit

basin.protocol: 48 ICs uniform in [-2,2]^3, rng seed 0, dt 0.005, batched complex RK4 (atlas.family_d), escape |X|>50; bounded count at T=120; landing on T in (200,300], every 10th step, rho_id <= 0.02 vs the B5 reference

comparison_same_protocol.Aurelia: 48/48 landed (48 bounded at T=120); 480-IC bounded fraction 1.0
comparison_same_protocol.Naiad: 48/48 landed (48 bounded at T=120); 480-IC bounded fraction 1.0
comparison_same_protocol.Cassiopea: 43/48 landed (43 bounded at T=120); 480-IC bounded fraction 0.9
comparison_same_protocol.Mobula: 41/48 landed (41 bounded at T=120); 480-IC bounded fraction 0.8521

basin.reconciliation: the selection stage (results/d3_selection.json) reported 29/48 bounded from a different IC draw (rng seed 7 after reference subsampling, dt 0.004, T = 300); the shared comparison protocol used for Aurelia/Naiad/Cassiopea/Mobula (rng seed 0, dt 0.005, T = 120) gives the n_bounded_T120 count recorded here, and the 480-IC sample in basin_large_sample gives the bounded fraction with its standard error

basin_large_sample.protocol: 480 ICs uniform in [-2,2]^3, rng seed 1, otherwise identical to the basin protocol

basin_near_attractor.protocol: 48 ICs = random B5 orbit points + uniform(-0.1,0.1)^3, rng seed 5; same integration and landing rule as the basin protocol

basin_near_attractor_wide.protocol: 480 ICs = random B5 orbit points + uniform(-0.3,0.3)^3, rng seed 6; same integration and landing rule
basin_near_attractor_wide.note: a +-0.3 box around an attractor point can reach outside the basin; such ICs leave at once (see escape_times), none escape after settling

image_launch.early_equivariance_kappa_note: bitwise exact by construction (the real-form arithmetic is exactly odd under kappa), so it is reported, not gated
image_launch.cloud_launch: x0, kappa x0 + 1e-6 N(0,1)^3, rho x0 + 1e-6 N(0,1)^3 (rng seed 13)
image_launch.decorrelation_definition: first time the orbit from the displaced image differs from the group image of the x0 orbit by more than 1e-3

equilibrium_checks.search: 600 fsolve seeds in [-3,3]^3 (seed 0) plus the six D3 images of every root, each polished by fsolve
equilibrium_checks.origin_note: saddle with the double real eigenvalue -beta (rotation rate omega*z vanishes at z=0) and nu along z; not a saddle-focus, so the homoclinic story of the C_n specimens does not transfer

novelty_vs_dysts.hedge: catalog-relative shape distance against 135 dysts systems, not a literature claim

novelty_vs_atlas.method: fingerprint of each specimen's default trajectory() (500k steps at dt 0.004) [::8] vs the Trinacria 4M-step orbit [::8]

lyapunov_single_orbit.note: B1 gate measurement: one continued orbit, T = 3000. It is one draw from the across-IC scatter recorded in dt_convergence (sd of T = 2000 means ~0.01); the headline spectrum is the ensemble mean.

dt_convergence_summary.format: per dt: ensemble of the same ICs (points of a short orbit + uniform(-0.1,0.1)^3, rng seed 21), T = 2000 after a T = 100 transient; mean and standard error across ICs. Spot check dt 0.000625: same 24 ICs, T = 500

lyapunov_settings.source: ensemble mean of dt_convergence at dt = 0.00125 (finest)

lambda1_quoted: 0.328 +- 0.002 (ensemble mean +- SE, 24 orbits x T = 2000 at dt 0.00125); a single T = 2000 orbit scatters by +- 0.009; quote as 0.33 +- 0.01

ic_consistency.protocol: 5 ICs = random points of a short orbit from DEFAULT_STATE + uniform(-0.3,0.3)^3 (rng seed 11); QR 150k steps at dt 0.005 after 20k transient steps

near-attractor ICs (+-0.3): every bounded orbit lands; escapes reported
image launch: early rho-equivariance <= 1e-8 (kappa is bitwise exact, reported)
image launch: displaced images decorrelate (> 1e-3) before sampling
image launch: cross-cloud residuals <= 1.5 x floor
image launch: fingerprint distances < 0.0549 (v1, reported only)
ensemble |P(z>0) - 0.5| <= 3 SE and <= 0.01
ensemble KS(z, -z) <= 0.02 (40k pooled points)
ensemble counter-rotation: omega above/below opposite, equal within 3 combined SE
ensemble counter-rotation within 5% of mean speed (v1)
single B5 orbit: |P-0.5| <= 0.01, KS <= 0.02, counter-rotation v2 (weak, ~1.5 sigma)

nearest catalog distance > 0.110 (interpretable)
nearest catalog distance > 0.115 (distinct)
distance to Aurelia > 0.110 before shape-novelty wording

verdict.basin_disclosure: 24/48 random ICs in [-2,2]^3 stay bounded and 24 land on the symmetric set; 24 escape to infinity (shared protocol, rng seed 0); 480-IC sample: bounded fraction 0.5625 +- 0.0226, 270/270 bounded orbits land on the symmetric set
verdict.headline_lambda1: 0.328 +- 0.002 (ensemble mean +- SE, 24 orbits x T = 2000 at dt 0.00125); a single T = 2000 orbit scatters by +- 0.009; quote as 0.33 +- 0.01

headline_spectrum.source: ensemble mean of dt_convergence at dt = 0.00125 (finest)

verdict.slow_convergence_note: the orbit exchanges the two halves slowly (dwell up to ~40 time units), so single-window averages (centroid, P(z>0), KS, angular velocities) scatter by about 1.5 times their thresholds' distance from the ideal value; those gates are taken on the 64-orbit ensemble with across-orbit standard errors, and the single-orbit values are reported with z-scores
verdict.note: gates of kind 'gate' decide certification; B9a-strict is the pre-registered 48/48 basin gate, replaced for this specimen by the user-accepted B9a-relaxed gate with the escape fraction disclosed; 'report', 'beauty' and 'interpretation' rows do not decide certification
